positive_fixed_rule: At most one choice per cycle, no retries within a cycle.
Exclude previously chosen lane centers. For each remaining center, count currently eligible grains outside the union of prior XY corridor footprints.
Rank descending new spatial grains, then descending total eligible grains, then ascending abs(x-.38), then ascending x. No random tie breaking.
If best new spatial count<50, safe-stop incomplete/failed; do not pretend five cycles completed or relax the rule.
Otherwise translate only source-stage X and execute that one unchanged spoon motion; record choice, all seven scores, fresh observation step/time, and all outcomes.
